items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: The first man gave me ideas about getting those old, Leonard Bishy, the old dentist. He was a dentist and formed me a trombone player... He bought a method for me himself

ctx.x: Did you ever have any lessons later on? You mentioned you'd like a snare drum.

I mentioned what, I had some ideas in line. The first man gave me ideas about getting those old, Leonard Bishy, the old dentist. He was a dentist and formed me a trombone player, but he didn't keep it as a profession. He played it as a sideline. Old Doc Bishy, yeah. He bought a method for me himself, from Philip Woylein Music still. And I used to get to come up with a man, Louis Contrell, sometimes, to give me different pointers about it. And working with different bands, guys help you out, you understand how it…
